project.name: Bezel roadmap
project.description: Single source of truth for milestones, epics and issues. Edit this file, re-run bootstrap.sh (idempotent) and the GitHub project follows.

labels.name: type:epic
labels.description: Tracking issue for a body of work

labels.name: type:spike
labels.description: Time-boxed investigation; output is a decision or ADR

labels.name: type:adr
labels.description: Decision record to write or revise

labels.name: blocked
labels.description: Waiting on an upstream or a decision

milestones.title: 0.0 Phase 0 — contract + webview spike
milestones.description: Prove the boundary: WIT v0.1, webview host, Rust then Python guest, 10k-row list at 60 fps with zero per-frame crossings. Exit criteria in feasibility §11.

milestones.title: 0.1 It runs
milestones.description: Webview host on 3 OSes, Rust + Python SDKs, dev loop, 3 examples, conformance in CI. Exit: the log viewer is something Justin uses at work.

milestones.title: 0.2 It ships
milestones.description: bezel pack (signed installers), Web host, capabilities manifest, docs site, packages published. Exit: a stranger ships an app from the README.

milestones.title: 0.3 It grows
milestones.description: TypeScript SDK, canvas element, optional platform interfaces, plugin composition, N-1 contract support, RFC process.

milestones.title: Native host (gated)
milestones.description: Masonry/Vello host behind the same contract. Opens only when the Phase 3 gate in the roadmap is met.

epics.title: Contract v0.1: the bezel:ui world
epics.body: Define and stabilise the first version of the contract. Nothing host-specific may appear. Every element gets a docs/elements/<name>.md with a Native-host mapping section.

issues.title: Write wit/tree.wit: node resource, element enum, prop variant, apply, set-root
issues.body: Per architecture §04 and feasibility §10. Include synchronous value() for host-owned state.

issues.title: Write wit/style.wit: layout subset (flex/grid/box model), colour, typography tokens
issues.body: Layout half mirrors Taffy's supported subset exactly so the Native host is a 1:1 mapping later.

issues.title: Write wit/events.wit: semantic event record + subscribe() -> stream<event>
issues.body: WASI 0.3 stream. Events carry u32 node id, kind, optional text/key. No raw pointer events in v0.1.

issues.title: Write wit/capabilities.wit and wit/window.wit
issues.body: granted(), request() -> future<bool>; window title/size/close handshake.

issues.title: Contract lint: denylist of DOM/CSS/JS identifiers + required element docs
issues.body: CI job that fails if any WIT identifier matches the denylist (innerHTML, className, selector, onclick, div, span, px…) or an element lacks docs/elements/<name>.md with a '## Native host mapping' heading.

issues.title: Spike: resources vs u32 ids for nodes — measure drop semantics and SDK ergonomics
issues.body: Confirm ADR-004. Output: keep or revise.

issues.title: Publish bezel:ui@0.1.0 to a WIT registry (warg or OCI) and pin from SDKs
issues.body: So SDKs and hosts consume the same artifact rather than a path.

epics.title: bezel-core: tree, style resolution, event routing, Backend trait
epics.body: The host-agnostic heart. Wasmtime bindings via component::bindgen!, retained tree, sparse→absolute style resolution, event router, and the Backend trait every host implements.

issues.title: Workspace skeleton: crates, CI matrix (3 OS), rustfmt/clippy/deny
issues.body: cargo workspace per architecture §03 repo layout. GitHub Actions matrix ubuntu/macos/windows.

issues.title: wasmtime bindgen! of the app world with component-model-async; Host impls for tree/events/capabilities
issues.body: Wasmtime 46+. Store per app instance. ResourceTable for nodes.

issues.title: Retained element tree with stable u32 ids, parent/child ops, dirty tracking
issues.body: Ids never reused within a session. Ops validated; a bad op fails the whole batch with an event to the app.

issues.title: Style resolver: sparse style + theme + inheritance → absolute style
issues.body: Backends never resolve. Output struct maps 1:1 to CSS props and to Taffy Style + paint props.

issues.title: Backend trait + RecordingBackend for golden-tree tests
issues.body: mount/create/set_prop/append/remove/destroy/value/commit/poll_events.

issues.title: Event router: host events → stream<event> with per-node listen filters
issues.body: Only nodes with listen(kind) props generate events. Coalesce change events per frame.

issues.title: Epoch interruption + memory limit per instance; trap → error state, host survives
issues.body: PRD H-3. Fault-injection test: app loops forever, UI stays responsive, reload works.

issues.title: Hot reload: drop instance, re-instantiate, replay recorded tree; optional snapshot/restore exports
issues.body: Window must not flash empty. Measure reload time; target < 1 s for Rust and Python example edits.

issues.title: Bench: 1,000-op apply must encode+cross+apply in < 2 ms
issues.body: PRD C-4. criterion bench in CI with a threshold.

epics.title: Webview host: tao + wry + DOM runtime
epics.body: The first host. UI thread owns tao/wry; app thread owns Wasmtime. Binary patch/event channel. The DOM runtime is a single TS package shared with the Web host.

issues.title: Process skeleton: tao window + wry webview on UI thread, Tokio + Wasmtime on app thread, channels between
issues.body: Architecture §07. Crash isolation from day one.

issues.title: runtime/dom (TS): apply binary patches to DOM, encode events, string interning
issues.body: No app logic ever. Typed-array fast path. Length-prefixed frames.

issues.title: Binary frame format for patches and events (spec in docs/protocol.md) + Rust encoder/decoder
issues.body: Varints, interned strings, op codes. Versioned header.

issues.title: Element → DOM mapping for all v0.1 elements incl. host-owned state readback
issues.body: input/textarea/checkbox/select state lives in DOM; value() reads via synchronous IPC or a mirrored cache updated by change events.

issues.title: List virtualisation: request-rows(range) event, windowed DOM, zero per-frame crossings
issues.body: The Phase 0 exit test: 10k rows at 60 fps.

issues.title: CSP: no remote content, no eval, only the embedded runtime; custom bezel:// scheme for assets
issues.body: PRD H-2. Security test that tries to inject a script via every prop and fails.

issues.title: Keyboard navigation and accessibility pass across all elements on Win/mac/Linux
issues.body: PRD H-6. Correct roles/names; focus order; visible focus ring from the default theme.

issues.title: Dev overlay: crossings/frame, patch bytes, first-paint time, capability denials
issues.body: Toggle with a key chord in `bezel dev`.

issues.title: Startup path: precompiled .cwasm load in parallel with webview init; measure first paint
issues.body: PRD H-4 targets. Publish numbers per OS.

issues.title: Generate bindings from bezel:ui with wit-bindgen; publish `bezel` crate skeleton
Element builders + per-turn batching (queue ops, flush on await/return)

issues.body: Elm/Xilem-flavoured. Keep it small; it is not the product.

issues.title: Examples: counter, todo, log-viewer in Rust
issues.body: Same behaviour as the Python versions; conformance-checked.

epics.title: Python SDK (beachhead)
epics.body: The SDK adoption depends on. Declarative element classes, async handlers, invisible batching, dataclass state snapshots for hot reload. Packaged size and startup are release gates.

issues.title: Spike: componentize-py against bezel:ui — binary size, startup, async stream support with WASI 0.3
issues.body: Output: numbers vs PRD H-4/S-6 budgets and a go/no-go on Python as beachhead (ADR-005).

issues.title: Declarative element classes (Box, Text, Input, Button…) over generated bindings
issues.body: No module named wit/wasm/component visible to users.

issues.title: Async event dispatch + per-turn batching that users never see
issues.body: Property assignment queues an op; flush at end of handler.

issues.title: State snapshot/restore for plain dataclasses (hot reload keeps state)
Examples: counter (≤ 20 lines), todo, log-viewer in Python
issues.body: PRD S-2.

issues.title: Size + startup work: pre-import snapshot, wasm-opt, .cwasm; hit ≤ 40 MB / ≤ 900 ms
issues.body: PRD S-6, H-4. Track per commit.
